newsitem.title: JAPAN: Earthquake hits southern Japan, no damage reported.
newsitem.headline: Earthquake hits southern Japan, no damage reported.

text.p: An earthquake measuring 5.7 on the Richter scale struck Japan's southern islands on Monday, the Meteorological Agency said.
There were no immediate reports of casualties or damage.
The tremor, with its epicentre near Tanegashima island, 1,000 km (625 miles) south of Tokyo, occured at 1.34 p.m. (0434 GMT), the Meteorological Agency said.
There was no danger of tidal waves, the agency said.
